title: Review return
purpose: Decide whether a returned specimen may be used again.
summary: Decide whether a returned specimen may be used again. Managers and administrators only.

tasks.title: Review the return
steps: Choose Release for use or Keep on hold in [[Decision]].
Enter [[Reviewed at]] and the [[Reason]], then select [[Record review]].

tasks.title: Find returns awaiting review
steps: On Returns, set Review to Awaiting review.

good_to_know: Release for use releases the hold placed on return.
Keep on hold can be reviewed again later.
Earlier reviews are shown on the form.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Managers and administrators, while the return has not been released for use. The form shows the return and any earlier reviews. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.

items.label: Decision
items.description: Required: Release for use (the hold placed on return is released) or Keep on hold (it can be reviewed again later).

items.label: Reviewed at
items.description: Required; repository local time, not in the future.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, for example the seal and the reported thaws. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: What happens
paragraphs: The review is recorded on the return. Disposal of returned material stays a separate disposal request approved by another person. If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
